notes.purpose: Evidence for bounded output and explicit full-frame filtered fallbacks; not a performance claim.
notes.filteredHighDepth: Filtered 10-bit and 12-bit decode reconstructs padded full-frame native-depth YUV before bounded RGBA row emission; downscale does not reduce that reconstruction working set.
notes.maximumRss: Absolute process high-water mark from process.resourceUsage().
notes.externalAndArrayBuffers: Sampled after decoder creation and every public output block.
notes.baseline: Captured after five explicit GC and event-loop turns with input retained; inherited high-water marks are rejected.
notes.correctness: Every run must match a checksum-pinned encoded or RGBA output.
